nodes.description: Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates init, _mints, delegate, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor using unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, written by approve and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor from the untrusted _supply argument.
Whitelist mapping granting accounts an exemption from the sale conditions; set by _mints.
Maximum number of sales per account, configured by init and read by condition.
Per-account sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Whitelisted trade address, set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Minimum sale amount, configured by init and enforced by condition.
Maximum sale amount, configured by init and enforced by condition.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist check that recomputes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and falls back to condition().
Public payable transfer entry point with unchecked allowance/balance mutations and a call to ensure().
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unchecked, including for the owner's infinite approval.
Internal view sale-policy gate reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Mint/whitelist function gated by an equality check against msg.sender and a hardcoded address; sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only sale-parameter initialiser writing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution using multiplication and unchecked loop accounting.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation from a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor assigning owner = msg.sender and granting an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
SafeERC20 private helper that verifies the token is a contract and performs a low-level call with optional return decoding.
Address library helper using extcodehash to determine whether an account is a contract.
Internal ERC20 transfer that moves balances and emits Transfer, reached from transfer and transferFrom.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance accounting and balance mutations.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker-supplied code in the storage context of this contract.
address(token).call(data) forwards an arbitrary encoded call to a caller-influenced token address.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath, allowing underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath, allowing integer overflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath, allowing allowance underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve/batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom/ensure/condition.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Local accumulator in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.
Local variable in ensure holding the computed pairFor address.
Array of recipient addresses passed to batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Maximum per-account sale count parameter of init.
Loop index variable of batchSend.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when decrementing allowance in transferFrom.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
approve stores allowance under the untrusted msg.sender key.
delegate is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints authorises the caller through msg.sender equality checks.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and pre-funds that address.
The owner-gated delegate function reaches an arbitrary delegatecall sink.
callOptionalReturn forwards an arbitrary call to an external token, enabling reentrant callbacks.
The external token call can re-enter this contract before the SafeERC20 helper returns.
callOptionalReturn checks address(token).isContract() before calling.
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from, _to, _value) as a precondition.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] with unchecked math.
transferFrom increments balanceOf[_to] with unchecked math.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked math.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
ensure recomputes the Uniswap pair with pairFor.
ensure falls back to condition for non-whitelisted senders.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend adds _value to each recipient balance inside the loop without overflow protection.
condition reads the _saleNum limit state variable.
condition reads the per-account _onSaleNum counter.
condition enforces the _minSale threshold.
condition enforces the _maxSale threshold.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] with a caller-influenced amount.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, bypassing the sale gate.
init writes the _minSale parameter.
init writes the _maxSale parameter.
init writes the _saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
The constructor mints totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor grants an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the untrusted _supply argument.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transfer reaches the internal _transfer accounting routine via transferFrom.
transferFrom reaches the internal _transfer accounting routine.
The _to parameter flows into transferFrom destination accounting.
The _value parameter flows into the transferFrom transfer amount.
The _value parameter is subtracted directly from the allowance without SafeMath.
The _from parameter flows into the transferFrom source accounting.
The _from parameter keys the unchecked balanceOf subtraction.
The _from parameter is passed to ensure for whitelist evaluation.
The _spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
The total local variable is the result of the unchecked multiplication.
The _UNI local variable is compared against _from inside ensure.
The _tos array drives the batchSend distribution loop.
The addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
The saleNum parameter configures _saleNum in init.
The loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to destination parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
The _value amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction and can be merged into that unsafe operation.
The _from source parameter is the spine of transferFrom accounting and should be folded into the transferFrom node.
The _spender parameter exists only to write the allowance entry inside approve.
The total local variable is exactly the result of the unchecked multiplication and is fully captured by that unsafe operation node.
The _UNI local variable is a temporary comparison value used only inside ensure.
The _tos recipient array has no meaning outside the batchSend loop.
The addr parameter is a pass-through value assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress.
The saleNum parameter is consumed only by init to set _saleNum.
The loop index i is a purely local artefact of the batchSend iteration.
